name: Mattea Meyer
bio: Mattea Julia Meyer is a Swiss politician of the Social Democratic Party (SP/PS). Born 9 November 1987 in Basel and raised in Rothenfluh and Winterthur, she has been a member of the National Council (Nationalrat) for the canton of Zurich since 2015. Since 17 October 2020 she co-chairs the SP Switzerland together with Cedric Wermuth, succeeding Christian Levrat. She previously served as a member of the Cantonal Council (Kantonsrat) of Zurich from 2011 to 2015 and on the municipal council of Winterthur from 2010 to 2011. She studied history, geography and political science at the University of Zurich and holds a master's degree in human and economic geography (2015/2016). She is associated with the party's left wing and is known for her work on social-policy, taxation, asylum and gender-equality issues.
